title: Japan Voted Condé Nast's 'Top Country'
paragraphs: Japan has been chosen as the "Top Country in the World" by readers of the US edition of Condé Nast Traveler magazine. This is the fourth year in a row that Japan has come first.

Almost 800,000 readers took part in the magazine's 39th Readers' Choice Awards for the world's best travel experiences. Awards are given based on readers' votes in categories that include countries, cities, hotels and cruises.
In the "Top Country" category, Japan came first, followed by Italy in second place and Ireland in third.

In a statement, the Japan National Tourism Organization (JNTO) said the result was not just because of Japan's strong tourism resources but also because of special Japanese qualities such as hospitality and safety.

Condé Nast Traveler also has a UK edition, which has its own annual Readers' Choice Awards. This year, UK readers chose Greece as the "Best Country in the World" with Japan coming second and Italy coming third.

The UK magazine said that tourism was booming in Japan because of its incredible restaurants, relaxing hot spring resorts, and its high-speed trains "which run along some of the most scenic rail routes in the world."

A record 42.7 million visitors from abroad came to Japan in 2025, according to government data. And in September, the World Economic Forum (WEF) named Japan as the top country in the world for travel and tourism.

The WEF said that Japan's tourism boom was partly thanks to efforts by the JNTO to attract travelers from a wider range of countries, while also encouraging travelers to visit areas outside the big cities like Tokyo, Hiroshima and Osaka.
